description: Full record of one GB operator licence by its number: holder (company name and number; never a sole trader's or partner's name), licence type, status, vehicles and trailers authorised, continuation date, operating centres, Companies House status, DVSA earned recognition, upcoming public inquiries, Traffic Commissioner decisions, Gazette insolvency notices and the change history between DVSA files. Licences no longer in the latest file are returned with in_current_file: false.

licence_number.description: Operator licence number, e.g. OB1234567 (O = goods, P = PSV; second letter = traffic area)

name: get_licence

attribution.description: Attribution text to show with the data

canonical_url.description: The human-readable HaulierScope page for this result

anyOf.description: goods = goods vehicles (HGV); psv = buses and coaches

dissolved_verified.description: Companies House reports the company dissolved, checked by company number AND name. Never inferred from a number missing in the live-company file

name_mismatch.description: The registered name is unlike the DVSA operator name: the company number on the DVSA record may belong to another company, so the other facts are omitted

not_found_in_live_file.description: The company number was not found in the Companies House live-company file (unverified: often a mistyped DVSA number). Not the same as dissolved

register_date.description: Companies House register date these facts describe

status.description: Company status code (active, liquidation, administration, receivership, dissolved, not_on_register, …)

continuation_date.description: Continuation date (when the operator must confirm details and pay the fee). Not an expiry date.

list_date.description: Date of DVSA's earned recognition list

history.description: Changes between DVSA files, newest first (companies only)

company_url.description: HaulierScope page listing all licences of this company

name.description: Operator name; null for sole traders and partnerships and for withheld names

type.description: company = limited company or LLP; other = public body, charity or similar; sole_trader_or_partnership = an individual (name never published here)

in_current_file.description: False = the licence is not in the latest DVSA file (the file does not say why; never read it as 'revoked')

licence_type.description: Standard International, Standard National, Restricted or Special Restricted

not_in_file_since.description: Date of the first DVSA file the licence was missing from

address.description: Street line; companies and organisations only (null for sole traders/partnerships)

postcode.description: Full postcode; companies and organisations only

anyOf.description: Licence status in the DVSA file. 'unmapped' = a status code we have not mapped yet; never treat it as valid.

code.description: Traffic area letter, the second letter of the licence number (B, C, D, F, G, H, K, M)

grounds.description: Legislation the inquiry is called under, as published

publication.description: Traffic Commissioner publication (Applications and Decisions, or Notices and Proceedings)

withheld.description: True when the record is withheld at the holder's request: only the licence number is given

file_date.description: Date of the DVSA operator licence file the data describes (null before the first import)

markdown_url.description: Markdown version of the canonical page

retrieved_at.description: When this response was generated (ISO timestamp)

source.description: Data source(s) the result is built from

source_url.description: Where the primary source dataset is published

title: Get an operator licence
